audio_description:
A sleek dark green-and-black armored train races along the tracks.
The camera follows it from behind, speeding through green countryside.
A high aerial view watches the long train cross the landscape.

context.summary: A sleek, dark green-and-black armored bullet train trimmed with gold filigree and red panels races along the tracks. Sweeping external camera angles follow it from the side, from behind, and from high above as it speeds through bright green countryside under a cloudy blue sky.
